contract.compatibility: Additive API 1 capability. Existing messages, native gates, owner protocol, space-move API and legacy original_host remain unchanged. Negotiate capabilities, not exact package equality.

lookup_findings: original_host is receipt-derived launch/move provenance, not complete live membership; legacy owner-managed sessions can lack it.
api spaces is a generation-bound per-session move-choice helper; Agent DM serial per-session refresh is not needed for graph placement.
New metadata uses the existing single HERDR snapshot per verified bound host; pane/tab/Space identity must agree.
client_adoption: Use state session placement directly; no original_host/spaces join.
Key graph nodes by opaque host_id and space.id, never labels or native IDs. Hosts with duplicate labels/native Space IDs stay distinct.
Match catalog_generation when merging a separate placements batch. State captures both in one catalog projection.
Retain last_known placement with its evidence timestamp/reason; do not display it as currently verified. Unknown remains unknown.
Join standalone placement history to the desired archive-filtered state list by stable session ID. Host Space catalog is retained history, not proof that every listed Space still exists.
Review and pin this immutable executable independently; Agent DM source/config were not modified.

focused_coverage: same labels and native IDs on different hosts
tmux and unknown placement not inferred

limits: Previously unobserved stopped histories have unknown placement; no retrospective guess from names or caller focus.
Identities persist within this data root and explicit HERDR endpoint/server namespace. Endpoint relocation or native ID reuse after replacing a host is not inferred as continuity.
Out-of-band attachment loss/change retains last-known membership until ownership is verified again; this read API does not repair or launch agents.
Existing legacy binding target namespaces must remain unambiguous; this adds no remote-host adoption or socket discovery.

Discovery retains its existing inventory costs; installed state took 5.594 seconds and the standalone placement batch took 3.307 seconds for eight live sessions. No additional per-session Space RPC is required.
Freshness is 30 seconds and independent of readiness. Last-known evidence never authorizes lifecycle/message operations.
